request.deadline: 18 months from programme start, with milestone gates at Month 6, Month 12, and Month 18
deliverables: 18-month programme across India, Cambodia, and Kenya

M1 Month 6: Foundation operational, 200,000 cumulative farmers registered on Mainnet, AE credentialing live, trust-layer architecture locked, auditor procurement concluded, legal contract transfer prepared
M2 Month 12: 350,000 farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya, three application paths operating against verified records, first independent audit, first stablecoin-rail loans disbursed and tracked
M3 Month 18: 500,000 cumulative verified farmers, three application paths operating, finance activity on Cardano, AE network credentialed, Foundation revenue model active, final independent audit
Public on-chain KPI dashboard, quarterly narrative reports, and monthly Cardano Forum updates
request.recipient: 5am.earth Foundation, with pre-Foundation co-promoters Elk GMBH and HashPoint Consulting until registration, administered by Intersect under the stated treasury reserve smart contract framework.
request.what: Build an open, Cardano-anchored trust layer for global agricultural supply chains combining Veridian self-sovereign identity with a Cardano on-chain satellite oracle and three application paths across AE certification, traceability/compliance, and finance/credit.

claims.claim: The proposal requests a hard cap of 10,000,000 ADA with milestone-gated payments of 5,000,000 ADA on approval, 2,000,000 ADA at M1, and 3,000,000 ADA at M2.
Project Swaminathan is operating on Cardano Mainnet with 10,500 cumulative farmer and farm registrations as of 5 May 2026.
The pilot phase from January to March 2026 validated 1,056 farms at a 100% blockchain success rate and handled a same-day critical patch with zero downtime.
The funded programme targets 500,000 registered farmers, 2 million on-chain transactions, and $2 million in lending disbursed via Cardano stablecoin rails by M3.
The proposal projects 3 million farmers, 112.5 million annual on-chain transactions, $900 million TVL, and 16-20 million ADA in annual protocol revenue by 2030.

The trust-layer technical components are described as already implemented and operational, including AIQuant and Anastasia Labs smart contracts, DigiFarm satellite imagery, Veridian DID stack, Andamio credentials, and NMKR tokenisation.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds through the Sundae Labs Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and Project-Specific Smart Contract framework with an Oversight Committee of five external entities.
The proposal states that the 10,000,000 ADA ask is approximately 2.86% of the ratified 350,000,000 ADA Net Change Limit.
The proposal states that surplus above $3.5 million returns to the Treasury, while the Foundation retains up to $3.5 million for scope elasticity.
The Foundation is projected to become self-sustaining by 2028 through commercial revenue and institutional backing without returning to the Treasury for operating costs.

summary: The document describes a 10,000,000 ADA, 18-month treasury request to scale an existing Cardano agricultural identity and data pilot into a multi-country trust layer with milestone gates, named partners, governance controls, and ambitious adoption and revenue projections, but several key economic and feasibility claims are primarily proposer assertions.
